note: MCP configuration linter rules. A hit is a review lead, not a verdict.

risky_args.title: Broad permission flag
risky_args.fix: Drop the flag and grant only the directories you need.

risky_args.title: Docker socket mounted
risky_args.fix: Socket access gives the container host power. Consider a read-only mount.

risky_args.title: Root or home directory shared
risky_args.fix: Limit it to the project directory.

risky_args.title: Launch through a shell
risky_args.fix: Use a direct executable when possible.

supply_chain.title: Unpinned npx launch
supply_chain.fix: Pin the package version, for example pkg@1.2.3, and review the postinstall script.

supply_chain.title: Unpinned uvx launch
supply_chain.false_positive: A tool resolved from a lockfile.

supply_chain.title: Remote MCP over plain HTTP
supply_chain.fix: Use HTTPS or terminate TLS in front of the server.

supply_chain.title: curl piped to a shell
supply_chain.fix: Download, read the script, then run it. Pin a checksum.

supply_chain.title: Skill allows any Bash
supply_chain.fix: Restrict with a command pattern where the skill only needs a few commands.
supply_chain.false_positive: A skill built around arbitrary commands.

supply_chain.title: Trust or sandbox flag relaxed
supply_chain.fix: Confirm the scope the flag opens.

supply_chain.title: postinstall script present
supply_chain.fix: Read the script before the first install.
supply_chain.false_positive: A build step that only compiles assets.

supply_chain.title: Remote plugin source
supply_chain.fix: Pin the source to a commit and review the diff before update.
supply_chain.false_positive: A source already pinned by tag.
